title: mmt-bench system-under-test record (sut.json)
description: Plan §B4. Every field is required. A field that could not be read holds an unavailable marker instead of a value; see docs/sut-fingerprint.md.

scope.description: host: written by mbench sut. run: embedded in a run by the runner, with tools, run times and pcaps filled.

dmi.description: Vendor and model (DMI). Serial numbers and the product UUID are never recorded.

items.description: One CPU type (dgx-spark: Cortex-X925 and Cortex-A725). Values are the first CPU's; a field listed in nonuniform_fields has every variant in variants.

host.description: Hardware. Covered by sut_hash, except hostname and hostname_anonymised.

under_test.description: Named with --nic: the interface under test. Its link state is hashed.

items.description: One NIC. Physical NICs are covered by sut_hash (without irqs[].effective_affinity); virtual ones (--nic) are not.
One tool under test, as its adapter reports it (#5).

noise.description: Background noise during the collection. Not covered by sut_hash.

items.description: One tool under test, as its adapter reports it (#5).

unavailable.description: A field that could not be recorded, with why.

identity_unavailable.description: An unavailable marker on a core identity field: the host does not expose it, it needs root, or the tool is missing. Never error, not_applicable or redacted: a record without these fields cannot be compared.

cgroup_limits.description: CPU, memory and cpuset limits of a cgroup (v2 file contents): the harness's own, or a run's container.
